# dsh-agent-board
Third-party DeepSeek Harness plugin: a durable per-workspace Agent Board on the web profile.
The Board button sits next to **Settings** at the bottom of the sidebar. It lists registered Workspa
ces; pick one to open that Workspace's board. The overlay, columns, cards, workers, and SQLite store
are the same as the in-tree Agent Board.
